['Lufthansa Technik AG '].company_description: Lufthansa Technik AG provides worldwide maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services for aircraft, engines, and components. It is a subsidiary of the Lufthansa Group, with headquarters at Hamburg Airport and major base maintenance facilities in various locations worldwide.
